name: io.github.tanya-ok/hipaa-fhir-mcp
title: HIPAA FHIR MCP (prototype)
description: Prototype: eight read-only FHIR R4 tools, per-patient grants and HMAC audit. Synthetic data only.

environmentVariables.name: AUDIT_HMAC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 64 hex characters used to HMAC patient ids in audit records

environmentVariables.name: FHIR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: FHIR R4 base URL; defaults to the public synthetic SMART sandbox

environmentVariables.name: CALLER_IDENTITY
environmentVariables.description: Operator label written into audit records, not an authenticated identity

environmentVariables.name: SMART_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: SMART Backend Services client id; set with SMART_KEY_ID and SMART_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.name: SMART_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: kid of the registered public key

environmentVariables.name: SMART_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a PEM private key, RSA 2048+ or EC P-384, mode 600

environmentVariables.name: PATIENT_POLICY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the JSON patient policy (principal, patients, tools); every tool call is denied when empty

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_PRINCIPAL
environmentVariables.description: Local fixture identity matched against the policy, not an authenticated caller; every tool call is denied when empty

environmentVariables.name: AUDIT_LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path for the audit file sink; stderr when empty
